title: Refactor TypeScript Kit to OOP Architecture with Kit Class
description: Refactor TypeScript Kit to OOP Architecture with Kit Class
summary: Continued the TypeScript OO/stateful migration in semio/js/index.ts. Moved diff, inverse diff, merge/apply, serialization, and projection behavior into class methods for geometry primitives and key graph entities, then reduced exported helpers to delegate into the class API. Added method-owned graph diff/apply APIs on Design, Type, Piece, and Kit and kept pointer-based object graph behavior for piece/type/design/kit relationships. Did not run tests or builds per instruction.
